pages.text: It was midday in midsummer. The bright sun sent everyone looking for a nap spot.
Lulu came with a blanket. "Let us nap together in the coolest shade."
Uncle Nino puffed out his chest. "I know shade best! Under that awning!"
They spread blankets beneath it. So cool!
Then wind blew. The awning edges flapped up.
Flap! Half the awning lifted away. Sunshine fell straight on the blankets.
Lulu moved the blanket under the olive tree. Dappled leaf shadows felt cool.
Wind could not pull the tree shade away. Only the leaves rustled.
Everyone slept softly under the tree. One leaf landed on Uncle Nino's tummy.
